payload.tension: The passage states women and men are greeted as coworkers, relatives, and prisoners. Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus, Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
